status: prospective new-source contract frozen before numeric Altitude values are opened

source.vertical_semantics: source WGS84 ellipsoidal altitude in metres
source.sampling: source metadata reports nocturnal fixes programmed at 10-minute intervals from sunset to sunrise
source.source_processing_boundary: public GPS data exclude locations within approximately 1 km of the protected roost

prohibited_before_vertical_opening: select individuals, sessions or grid based on altitude
alter structural or horizontal thresholds after horizontal result

projection.rule: derive UTM zone deterministically from median nonvertical longitude and latitude of all valid source rows; northern hemisphere uses EPSG 32600+zone, southern uses 32700+zone
projection.grid_origin: native UTM origin; no data-dependent translation

horizontal_individuality.role: prospective nonvertical axis metric frozen and opened before altitude
horizontal_individuality.cell_universe: all 5-km cells in the structurally retained >=50-fix repeat-individual session universe
horizontal_individuality.self_profile: equal-weight other eligible sessions of the target individual; each session cell distribution Jeffreys-smoothed over the frozen cell universe
horizontal_individuality.other_profile: pool eligible sessions within each other individual, Jeffreys-smooth over the frozen cell universe, then equal-weight other individuals
horizontal_individuality.target_score: mean target-event log P_self(cell) - log P_other(cell)
horizontal_individuality.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual
horizontal_individuality.null: whole-session identity permutation across the structurally retained session universe, preserving the exact session-count multiset per identity and recomputing complete profiles

vertical_preflight.target_common_support: target event's frozen 5-km cell must occur in at least one other eligible session of the same individual and at least one eligible session of another individual
vertical_preflight.estimator_evaluable_individual: at least one target session with >=50 common-support target events
freeze_before_altitude: exact vertically evaluable target sessions and supported-event counts

vertical_primary.vertical_centering: subtract the median source Altitude (m) of the full frozen eligible session before vertical binning
vertical_primary.self_profile: equal-weight other frozen eligible sessions of same individual
vertical_primary.other_profile: pool frozen eligible sessions within each other individual, then equal-weight other individuals
vertical_primary.common_cell_weighting: derive equal-session self horizontal weights on target-supported cells and apply identical weights to self and other vertical profiles
vertical_primary.target_score: mean supported target-event log P_self(centered z) - log P_other(centered z)
vertical_primary.aggregation: equal target session within individual, then equal individual
vertical_primary.null: whole-session identity permutation over the frozen training universe, preserving exact session-count multiset per identity; replay full support/profile/weighting pipeline
vertical_primary.pass_rule: calibrated excess > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

claim_boundary: This source is a new prospective source for the comparative-generality programme.
Public removal of roost-neighbourhood points is a fixed source property and must be reported; it is not altered.
Ellipsoidal altitude is not AGL. Session centering plus horizontal matching reduces but does not eliminate terrain-reference limitations.
A vertical FAIL remains in the comparative source set and cannot be rescued by alternate bins, grids, thresholds, absolute altitude or individual exclusions.
Horizontal individuality is an independent prospective axis metric and is reported regardless of the later vertical result.
